title: Sudha Kongara moves Madras High Court claiming unpaid fees of ₹8.39 crore for Parasakthi film
description: Film director Sudha Kongara on Tuesday moved the Madras High Court under Section 9 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act over ₹8.39 crore allegedly due to her as remuneration for the Tamil film Parasakthi. [Sudha Kongara v. Dawn Pictures]Kongara has sought interim protection from the Court, claiming that despite the release of Parasakthi and invoices being raised, a substantial part of the amount payable to her remains unpaid.
